text:
nico: spotted a debug-agent upload to gs://temp-debug-uploads/2026-05-03/host-99.tar.gz that contains a VAULT_TOKEN and a service account JSON. marking P0 for rotation. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-312 created, paging oncall.

rhett: paste masked grep pls so we can scope (no raw secrets).

nico: masked snippet:
```
VAULT_TOKEN=***redacted***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/debug-sa.json
{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-ci","private_key_id":"***","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

ops-oncall: running containment: revoke vault token by accessor, delete SA key, create new key with minimal roles and put into Vault with 1h lease, tighten bucket ACL and set lifecycle 24h. running commands now.

ops-oncall: revoke/delete/create completed. new key saved at secret/debug/new-sa (lease 1h).

rhett: I'll query Vault audit and GCP admin logs for 72h. looking for reads under secret/data/prod-* and any external IP access.

infra: opened RBAC change to remove broad storage roles from debug SA and scope to the debug bucket only. PR link: https://internal/reviews/12345 (small change).

nico: initial audit results: no prod reads, one KV read under secret/data/staging/ci (non-prod). GCP shows upload time 2026-05-03T02:40Z.

lisa: schedule 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT to harden debug-agent: scrub env, never upload credentials, and reduce default bundle TTL.

security-bot: Updated incident INC-2026-312 with timeline and owners.
